title: Rezoning for nursing home at 1455 Coney Island Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This approves a zoning map change at 1455 Coney Island Avenue in Midwood, Brooklyn, from an R5/C2-3 district to a C4-5D district. The change would allow a nine-story, about 157,000-square-foot long-term care facility with roughly 300 beds, office space, a café and a house of worship. The Council held a public hearing on September 23, 2026 and found no significant environmental impact.
